doc.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023

chapter: Harry James, Damone and Los Angeles
title: Vic Damone's band, replacing Buddy Childers
summary: Takes over from Buddy Childers in Vic Damone's band, then is offered Hollywood Palace and Pat Paulsen shows and Damone counters with a raise.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And you’re going to replace the gig with Harry James with what?

The great singer. Had great charts, really good charts. J. Hill did a bunch of them. And that was a great job too. He worked Vegas a lot, every year. And occasionally we’d go out for maybe like a weekend to Philadelphia to Palumbo’s or something and go out. But I worked with him and actually I replaced Buddy Childers there. Buddy Childers was the trumpet player for Vic and I replaced him. I stayed for a couple of years. And then my children were really small I got asked to play at the ABC Television in Los Angeles for the TV shows. Remember “Hollywood Palace” I don’t know if you remember that.

That was the last of the live shows by the way, no fixes. No fixes. That and then Pat Paulson “Half a Comedy Hour” it was called. And that was a small band. That was two trumpets, myself and Conte Candoli. It was an all-star band, it really was. Ray Brown
